schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-flask-mlflow-prompt-source-validation-bypass
title: Model version source validation skipped when request claims to be a prompt
summary: The create-model-version handler skips all source validation whenever the request is flagged
  as a prompt through a client-controlled tag. An attacker can set the prompt tag and supply a file://
  URI or absolute path as the source, bypassing the local-path checks. The server then reads arbitrary
  local files, which gives an arbitrary file read.
cwe:
- CWE-22
- CWE-863
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a
  vulnerable_ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a^
  patched_ref: 6e801f4259d96804c73107315b24cef0f6aa115a
  repository: https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow
rule:
  message: 'Source validation is skipped when a client-controlled "is prompt" flag is set. An attacker
    can

    set the prompt tag to bypass checks and pass file:// URIs or absolute paths as the source.

    Validate prompt sources too (reject local paths).

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: "$IS_PROMPT = _is_prompt_request($REQ)\n...\nif not $IS_PROMPT:\n    ...\n    _validate_source_run(...)\n\
      ...\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "$IS_PROMPT = _is_prompt_request($REQ)\n...\nif $IS_PROMPT:\n    ...\n    urllib.parse.urlparse(...)\n\
      \    ...\nelse:\n    ...\n"
fix:
  guidance: Never skip source validation based on a client-supplied prompt tag. For prompts, parse the
    source URI and reject file:// schemes and absolute local paths, and run the relative-path traversal
    check on any source that has a URL scheme. Only allow harmless schemeless placeholder sources. Keep
    the existing model and run source validation for non-prompt requests.
  example: "is_prompt = _is_prompt_request(request_message)\nif is_prompt:\n    source = request_message.source\n\
    \    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(source)\n    if parsed.scheme == \"file\" or (parsed.scheme ==\
    \ \"\" and source.startswith(\"/\")):\n        raise MlflowException(\"Local source paths are not\
    \ allowed for prompts.\",\n                              INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE)\n    if parsed.scheme:\n\
    \        _validate_non_local_source_contains_relative_paths(source)\nelse:\n    _validate_source_run(request_message.source,\
    \ request_message.run_id)\n"
